Meta Test Description: This testcase (mipi_csi2_rb_reg_wr_rd_test) is a MIPI CSI-2 Receive Block register write/read verification test for the MIPI_CSI IP. It performs: (1) chk_rst_val - iterates over 60 registers via addr_array, reads each using read_reg() and compares against default_value_array, skipping registers where read_mask_array is 0x00000000, tracking mismatches in def_fail_cnt; (2) chk_rd_wr - writes 0xFFFFFFFF to all writable registers (skipping those in skip_array or with write_mask_array==0x00000000), then reads back and compares data_rd against (data_wr & write_mask_array[i]), tracking mismatches in wr_fail_cnt; (3) soft_reset_chk - performs a soft reset by writing SOFT_RST_REG_DATA to SOFT_RST_REG_ADDRESS, waiting via wait_on(1000), then restoring the original value; (4) chk_rst_val is called again after soft reset to re-verify defaults. Final pass/fail is determined by (def_fail_cnt == 0) && (wr_fail_cnt == 0), returning 0 for PASS and 1 for FAIL.
